text:
sophie: heads up — onboarding sampleapp is failing on embed+rerank flow. JS SDK sanitizer is trimming trailing zeros from vectors, and the rerank payload key mismatch is turning that into 400s + duplicate retries.

cj: can you paste the server error + the exact request the SDK sent? :eyes:

sophie: server error: 
```
{"error":"bad_request","message":"rerank: item 3 vector length 1530 != model dim 1536"}
```
request body we sent (from client network tab):
```
{ "vectors": [ [0.12, 0.44, ..., 0.0 /* trimmed */], ... ], "query": "..." }
```

matt: 😬 that looks like sanitizer removed trailing zeros. The model expects 1536 floats; JS SDK must've removed trailing zeros to "compress" payload. That will break batching helpers that assume dims are stable.

irene: also seeing another hiccup in sampleapp: rerank expects `items[].vector` but our helper wraps into `vectors` top-level. server rejects and the retry logic in batch helper re-sends with empty vectors if validation fails.

cj: repro steps? minimizing: run sampleapp local with `yarn start` -> trigger onboarding flow -> watch network for POST /v1/rerank -> fails.

sophie: repro snippet:
```
// sdk call in sampleapp
await Redwood.embed.rerank({
  vectors: batch.map(v => sanitize(v)),
  query: q
})
// sanitize currently strips trailing zeros
```

matt: temporary workaround: pad vectors to model dim before sending and add a quick client-side assert. e.g.
```
function ensureDim(vec, dim=1536) {
  if (vec.length > dim) throw new Error('vec>dim')
  while (vec.length < dim) vec.push(0)
  return vec
}
```

irene: but that doesn't fix the schema mismatch. I'll open a tiny middleware in sampleapp to map `vectors` -> `items: [{vector, id}]` until SDK patch lands. add per-item idempotency key so retries don't duplicate.

devx-bot: PR opened: <https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp/pull/452> by irene — includes dim-assert + mapping middleware. CI tests added. :rocket:

cj: thanks. two asks: 1) can eng-runtime add a server-side warning if vector lengths vary so it's clearer (not just 400). 2) can SDK team add a `sanitizeVectors: false` option and a parity test for mobile/py/js so this doesn't drift?

sophie: filed SDK issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/289 — proposes `sanitizeVectors:false` + automatic pad option + unit tests. tagging @matt for JS patch.

matt: I'll branch a fix to stop trimming trailing zeros and add a compatibility toggle. also adding a pre-send validator in batch helper that: checks dims, injects idempotency keys, and refuses to fire if shape mismatch.

irene: can QA validate sampleapp with Canary 1.1.3? the PR has steps. cc @cj for regression test.

cj: will add a quick e2e to sampleapp smoke that asserts server accepts the rerank payload and no duplicate ids generated on transient 500s.

sophie: thanks team. leaving the thread with the repro logs and PR links in the issue. will follow up after JS patch lands. :white_check_mark:
